name: Hive 1.13.0
notes: Proposal refinement: a comment/change-request thread on every review proposal (humans and role-qualified agents), a Send-to-agent-to-revise action that produces a linked new version, approver/rejecter tagging, expandable cards, and a full-width diff viewer. File attachments now actually reach other members — sealed with the workspace key and delivered over the enterprise relay's E2EE blob channel (client + headless CLI); local-only when no relay. A new Edit files & run commands permission tier so coding agents can build/test without full bypass. Concurrency hardening: a stuck turn can no longer wedge a chat as permanently "responding" (a whole-turn timeout plus a manual Reset chat), and a chat in your local workspace always answers even when a relay is configured for your rooms. Plus review-pane button responsiveness, and cleared stale "generating" bubbles across device-identity resets.
